nao.label: NAO
nao.note: North Atlantic Oscillation. CPC-style pattern applied to the member's 500 hPa height anomaly; CPC-scale (annual standard deviations).

pna.label: PNA
pna.note: Pacific / North American. CPC-style pattern applied to the member's 500 hPa height anomaly; CPC-scale (annual standard deviations).

ao.label: Arctic Oscillation
ao.note: First EOF of sea-level pressure poleward of 20°N; positive = low pressure over the pole; ERA5 1991–2020 standard deviation for the calendar month.

ea.label: East Atlantic
ea.note: East Atlantic. CPC-style pattern applied to the member's 500 hPa height anomaly; CPC-scale (annual standard deviations).

wp.label: West Pacific

sca.label: Scandinavia
sca.note: Scandinavia. CPC-style pattern applied to the member's 500 hPa height anomaly; CPC-scale (annual standard deviations).

tnh.label: Tropical / Northern Hemisphere

pol.label: Polar / Eurasia

epo.label: EPO
epo.note: Eastern Pacific Oscillation. CPC-style pattern applied to the member's 500 hPa height anomaly; ERA5 1991–2020 standard deviation for the calendar month.

wpo.label: WPO
wpo.note: Western Pacific Oscillation. CPC-style pattern applied to the member's 500 hPa height anomaly; ERA5 1991–2020 standard deviation for the calendar month.

soi.label: Southern Oscillation index
soi.note: Tahiti minus Darwin sea-level pressure anomaly; unit: ERA5 1991–2020 standard deviation for the calendar month; negative with El Niño.

eqsoi.label: Equatorial SOI
eqsoi.note: Eastern equatorial Pacific minus Indonesian sea-level pressure anomaly (5°N–5°S boxes, CPC definition); unit: ERA5 1991–2020 standard deviation for the calendar month; negative with El Niño. The equatorial gradient that drives the Walker circulation, without the Tahiti–Darwin station noise.

u60n10.label: 60°N 10 hPa zonal wind
u60n10.note: Zonal-mean zonal wind, the standard vortex-strength metric; below zero is an easterly (reversed) vortex.

u60s10.label: 60°S 10 hPa zonal wind
u60s10.note: Zonal-mean zonal wind, the standard vortex-strength metric; below zero is an easterly (reversed) vortex.

qbo10.label: QBO: equatorial 10 hPa wind
qbo10.note: 5°S–5°N zonal-mean zonal wind, SEAS5's own QBO; westerly positive.

qbo30.label: QBO: equatorial 30 hPa wind
qbo30.note: 5°S–5°N zonal-mean zonal wind, SEAS5's own QBO; westerly positive.

qbo50.label: QBO: equatorial 50 hPa wind
qbo50.note: 5°S–5°N zonal-mean zonal wind, SEAS5's own QBO; westerly positive.

nam10.label: NAM at 10 hPa
